plugins.name: ace
plugins.description: v7.1.6: Bugfix: /ace:ace-graph project-name resolution. No floor bump. ace-graph name lookup now matches on project_id/project_name (ace-cli 4.x schema); was matching id/name so the lookup never found a match and the graph title showed the raw prj_… ID instead of the human name. v7.1.5: Command de-stale + ACE-1.5 insights + new knowledge-graph command. No floor bump. ace-test de-staled to ACE-1.5 model. .env.ACE_PROJECT_ID env-first in ace-clear/delta/export/import/learn. ace-insights now logs/surfaces cumulative_v15_reward/isAtRisk/n_hot_pos/n_hot_neg. NEW /ace:ace-graph command renders local ACE knowledge-graph as interactive HTML (cytoscape, force-directed; node color=domain, size=reward/degree, edge width=weight). v7.1.4: Concurrent-subagent degenerate-trace fix. No floor bump. Stage 1 — agent_id recovery from transcript path. Stage 2 — hygiene skip for fully anchorless SubagentStop traces. v7.1.3: Subagent session-anchoring correctness + SubagentStop observability. No floor bump. v7.1.2: Injection quality + correctness hardening. Quality gate keep iff NOT isAtRisk AND cumulative_v15_reward >= 0. Domain-shift bounded server-side via --top-k 8. Floor bump: ace-cli >= 4.1.2, @ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2. v7.1.1: Domain-shift session-pinning + strip/gate hardening. v7.1.0: Per-agent ACE attribution. Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.163, ace-cli >= 4.1.2 (@ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2).
